english:
Readying a weapon grants 7% increased Weakspot Damage against PvE Combatants for 4 seconds. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait and Tex Mechanica Exotics receive 15% instead.

The bonus also applies to hits on shielded enemies' weakspots and works with weapons that cannot normally deal Precision damage. It does not apply to a <exotic Divinity /> Bubble.

Eligible Tex Mechanica Exotics are <exotic Dead Man's Tale />, <exotic The Huckleberry />, <exotic The Last Word />, <exotic Tarrabah />, <exotic The Chaperone />, and <exotic The Prospector />.

source.text:
4 Piece | High Noon

Upon readying a weapon:
7% Increased Weakspot Damage against Combatants for 4 seconds.
Buffs "Precision Hits" against Shielded Combatants and works on weapons without Precision Multipliers as long as they hit the weakspot.
Weakspot Buffs do not work on a Divinity Bubble

Bonus is increased to 15% Increased Weakspot Damage for the following:
Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait and Tex Mechanica Exotics.
Dead Man's Tale | Huckleberry | Last Word | Tarrabah | Chaperone | Prospector
